items.followUp: What is a distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack?

rubric.description: Expands DoS as Denial of Service.
rubric.how: Award for correctly giving the expansion.

rubric.why: Explains the attack’s effect on service availability.
rubric.description: States that the attack overwhelms a computer or network, making its services unavailable to legitimate users.
rubric.how: Award for describing the disruption caused by the attack.

modelAnswer: A DoS (Denial of Service) attack overwhelms a computer or network with requests.
This makes its services unavailable to legitimate users.
